svg.title: Trustpilot detected 90 percent of removed fake reviews automatically in 2024
svg.desc: A horizontal band shows 90 percent detected by automated systems and the remaining 10 percent identified after user flags or manual investigations, according to Trustpilot.
svg.text: How those fake reviews were found
Trustpilot’s 2024 account of its 4.5 million detected fake review removals
The rest were identified after user flags or manual investigations. This does not measure business report success.
